proxy_host_help: The ESPHome proxy within radio range of the devices. Use it with this adapter only.
proxy_key_help: Base64 key from api: encryption: key of the proxy firmware. Stored encrypted.
seen_minutes_help: How long a device may be silent before it counts as not reachable.
poll_minutes_help: All devices are read one after the other in short Bluetooth connections. While the app is open, a device cannot be read.
clock_sync_help: Sets the clock of a device when it differs by 2 minutes or more (e.g. after a power cut). Commands always set the clock, like the app.
devices_hint: Enter your own devices only (MAC from the scan). A device connected to the app or the WiFi hub sends nothing and counts as not reachable. Seasonal devices (e.g. a fan used in summer) do not raise a warning.
power_hint: Power state (optional, fan and CO2 controller): state with the power in W, e.g. shelly.0.SHPLG-S#XXXXXX#1.Relay0.Power. It is only read, the plug is never switched. Fan: shows "running" and checks every level command (if the fan does not start, it is kicked: level 20, 11, 4, 20, 11, then the wanted level). CO2: shows "valve open".
